ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), OR( NOT(UPPER(Linkedin_URL__c) = 'N/A'), NOT(UPPER(Linkedin_URL__c) = 'NA') ), NOT(ISBLANK(Linkedin_URL__c)), NOT( OR( BEGINS(Linkedin_URL__c, "https://"), BEGINS(Linkedin_URL__c, "http://") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: LinkedIn URL is invalid. If the URL is not available, please write 'N/A'.
